capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Toyota USA: 74.7 kWh on XLE FWD Plus, XLE AWD, Limited FWD and Limited AWD (total capacity).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for the 74.7 kWh pack (bZ4X Touring AWD MY26, European listing of the same 74.7 kWh pack). Toyota US/Canada state only total capacity.

chemistry.notes: GreenCars relays Toyota's chief engineer: 'no change to the cell chemistry' for the 2026 bZ, i.e. nickel-manganese-cobalt cathodes; the 74.7 kWh pack is shared by both drive types. Relayed by press.

Estimated: Autopian quotes the chief engineer that the larger pack 'retains the same chemistry and cells as the previous version'; the previous packs were NMC (same article). Autopian never writes 'NMC' for the 74.7 kWh pack itself.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Autopian: pack voltage rose from 355 V to 391 V; InsideEVs: bZ 'still runs on a 400-volt electrical architecture'.
InsideEVs relays Toyota's chief engineer: the bZ 'still runs on a 400-volt electrical architecture'.

preconditioning.notes: Toyota USA: battery preconditioning standard on all models, activated manually or automatically when a fast-charging station is the navigation destination.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs relays Toyota: bZ 'still capped at 150 kilowatts'; GreenCars: charging 'will now peak at 150 kilowatts'. Model-level, not stated per pack.

ac_max_kw.notes: Toyota USA: 11 kW on-board charger, up from 7 kW on the prior model.

published_10_80_min.notes: Toyota USA: around 30 minutes 10-80% under ideal conditions (model-level).
